
	<h1 class="postTitle"><a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/lixingqiu/p/19570172" title="发布于 2026-02-03 16:31">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">《让子弹飞》之"插入排序办公室"风云</span>
    

</a>
</h1>
	<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2><img alt="插入排序算法可视化演示程序-封面" width="133" height="236" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/523461/202602/523461-20260203163037085-1980397574.jpg" class="lazyload"></h2>
<p><span style="font-size: 1.5em">先看视频，更好理解：</span><a style="font-size: 1.5em" href="https://www.douyin.com/video/7602545031836093731" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://www.douyin.com/video/7602545031836093731</a></p>
<h2>&nbsp;</h2>
<h2>第一幕：乱序入职</h2>
<p><img alt="插入01" width="241" height="63" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/523461/202602/523461-20260203162150018-1117789544.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="paragraph">场景：鹅城政务大厅，一群五颜六色的大小圆圈正在排队办入职手续。</div>
<div class="paragraph">张麻子（<code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">rocket</code>）拿着喇叭喊："都给老子站好！从左边开始，小的站前面，大的站后面！"</div>
<div class="paragraph">结果现场一片混乱——红色的块头小却站在最左边，青色的体积最大却夹在C位，紫色的却委曲的蹲在最右边...</div>
<div class="paragraph">旁白：这就是你的 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">datas</code> 向量，一群 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">Node</code> 结构体，带着各自的 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">value</code>（体重）和 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">sp</code>（ Sprite 造型），在 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">startX</code> 坐标处傻站着。</div>
<hr>
<h2>第二幕："关键先生"登场</h2>
<div class="paragraph">张麻子（指着 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">ptr</code> 粉色箭头）："你！从第二个开始，一个个往前审！"</div>
<div class="paragraph">马邦德（指着正在颤抖的橙圆圈）："大人，这橙圈在抖什么？"</div>
<div class="paragraph">张麻子："<code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">tremble()</code> 懂不懂？这叫'紧张'！它发现自己 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">value</code> 可能不对，正在怀疑人生！"</div>
<div class="paragraph">这时候，橙圆圈被标记为 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">key</code> ——关键先生临时出局，手里攥着自己的 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">value</code>，心里嘀咕："老子该站哪儿？"</div>
<blockquote>
<div class="paragraph">💡 插入排序精髓第一步：先抽出来，别急着站队！</div>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2>第三幕：往后挪！都给老子往后挪！</h2>
<div class="paragraph">名场面复刻：</div>
<div class="paragraph">张麻子掏出枪（代码里的 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">while</code> 循环），对着前面已经排好的队伍：</div>
<div class="segment-code" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">
<div class="syntax-highlighter light segment-code-content" data-v-efb858b9="" data-v-7caec4f8="">
<pre class="language-cpp" data-v-efb858b9=""><code class="language-cpp"><span class="token keyword">while<span class="token punctuation">(j<span class="token operator">&gt;=<span class="token number">0 <span class="token operator">&amp;&amp; key<span class="token operator">-&gt;value <span class="token operator">&lt; datas<span class="token punctuation">[j<span class="token punctuation">]<span class="token operator">-&gt;value<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">{
    <span class="token function">movebackward<span class="token punctuation">(j<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;   <span class="token comment">// 给我往后退！
    j<span class="token operator">--<span class="token punctuation">;
<span class="token punctuation">}</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div data-v-71e0e4ea="">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="paragraph">橙圈往前一看：前面的红圈 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">value</code> 比我大？</div>
<div class="paragraph">张麻子："红圈！<code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">movebackward(0)</code>！你，往后挪一位！"</div>
<div class="paragraph">红圈一脸懵逼地执行 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">go(newX, -50)</code>，骂骂咧咧地滑到了索引 1 的位置。</div>
<div class="paragraph">橙圈再往前看：前面没有了（j==0了)</div>
<div class="paragraph">于是橙圈兴高采列的滑到了索引为0的位置。</div>
<blockquote>
<div class="paragraph">💡 插入排序精髓第二步：<span>前面比咱大的，统统后移让位！ 这不是谦让，是算法暴力！</span></div>
</blockquote>
<hr>
<h2>&nbsp;</h2>
<h2>第四幕：周而复始，鹅城太平</h2>
<div class="paragraph">接下来，其它颜色的蓝圈、紫圈、粉圈依次被枪（&nbsp;<code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">ptr</code> 箭头)指到，重复这套"抽出来→前面大的后退→插入正确位置"的流程。</div>
<div class="paragraph">汤师爷（看着最后排好的队伍）："县长，这算法为什么叫'插入'啊？"</div>
<div class="paragraph">张麻子（吐烟圈）："因为每个人都是插入到已经排好的队伍里，就像插秧！不是冒泡那种换来换去的笨办法，也不是快排那种分而治之的洋玩意儿。"</div>
<div class="paragraph">张麻子（指着代码）："看见没？<code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">for(int i=1; i&lt;n; i++)</code>，从第二个开始，因为第一个默认就有序——一个人的队伍当然是有序的！"</div>
<hr>
<h2>大结局：ptr 退场，全体立正！</h2>
<div class="segment-code" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">
<div class="segment-code-header-content" data-v-7caec4f8=""><span class="segment-code-lang" data-v-7caec4f8=""><span class="segment-code-lang" data-v-7caec4f8="">cpp</span></span>
<div class="simple-button size-medium" data-v-182d5fe2="" data-v-92afdd37="" data-v-7caec4f8=""><span data-v-182d5fe2="">复制</span></div>
</div>
<div class="syntax-highlighter light segment-code-content" data-v-efb858b9="" data-v-7caec4f8="">
<pre class="language-cpp" data-v-efb858b9=""><code class="language-cpp">ptr<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">hide<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;  <span class="token comment">// 粉色箭头功成身退
rocket<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">write<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token string">"演示完毕！"<span class="token punctuation">,<span class="token number">42<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">.<span class="token function">done<span class="token punctuation">(<span class="token punctuation">)<span class="token punctuation">;  </span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div data-v-71e0e4ea="">&nbsp;</div>
<div class="paragraph">所有圆圈按 <code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">value</code> 从小到大，红橙黄绿青蓝紫，像彩虹一样整齐。</div>
<div class="paragraph">汤师爷："县长，这算法复杂度..."</div>
<div class="paragraph">张麻子："最坏情况 <span class="katex-wrapper" data-v-f1528c6f="" data-v-7bd7ca31=""><span class="katex-container" data-v-f1528c6f=""><span class="katex"><span class="katex-html"><span class="base"><span class="strut"><span class="mord mathnormal">O<span class="mopen">(<span class="mord"><span class="mord mathnormal">n<span class="msupsub"><span class="vlist-t"><span class="vlist-r"><span class="vlist"><span class="pstrut"><span class="sizing reset-size6 size3 mtight"><span class="mord mtight">2<span class="mclose">) ，最好 <span class="katex-wrapper" data-v-f1528c6f="" data-v-7bd7ca31=""><span class="katex-container" data-v-f1528c6f=""><span class="katex"><span class="katex-html"><span class="base"><span class="strut"><span class="mord mathnormal">O<span class="mopen">(<span class="mord mathnormal">n<span class="mclose">) ！但你别管，站着把钱挣了，就是优雅！"</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></div>
<hr>
<h2>后记：中心思想总结</h2>
<blockquote>
<div class="paragraph">插入排序就像张麻子整编鹅城保安队——</div>
<ol start="1">
<li>
<div class="paragraph">抓一个出来（<code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">key = datas[i]</code>）</div>
</li>
<li>
<div class="paragraph">前面块头大的统统后退（<code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">movebackward</code> 循环）</div>
</li>
<li>
<div class="paragraph">按个头插到该站的位置（<code class="segment-code-inline" data-v-7caec4f8="" data-v-7bd7ca31="">placekey</code>）</div>
</li>
<li>
<div class="paragraph">前面队伍永远有序，后面逐个加入</div>
</li>
</ol>
<div class="paragraph">核心口诀：抽、退、插，三步走，前面有序后面凑！</div>
</blockquote>

</div>
